# pidginhost_server (Data Source)

Looks up one server by id or hostname. Set exactly one of them; the lookup fails when no server or more than one server matches. Cancelled and terminated servers do not match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look a server up by exactly one of id or hostname.
data "pidginhost_server" "web" {
  hostname = "web1.example.com"
}

output "web_ipv4" {
  value = data.pidginhost_server.web.ipv4
}

output "web_private_addresses" {
  value = data.pidginhost_server.web.private_networks[*].address
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the server, compared without regard to case.
- `id` (String) Id of the server.

### Read-Only

- `cpus` (Number) Number of vCPUs.
- `destroy_protection` (Boolean) Whether the server is protected against being destroyed.
- `disk_size` (Number) Disk size, in GB.
- `generation` (String) Hardware generation the server runs on.
- `image` (String) Image the server was installed from.
- `ipv4` (String) Primary public IPv4 address. Empty when the server has none.
- `ipv6` (String) Primary public IPv6 address. Empty when the server has none.
- `memory` (Number) Memory, in GB.
- `package` (String) Package (size) of the server.
- `private_networks` (Attributes List) Private networks the server is a member of. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--private_networks))
- `project` (String) Project the server belongs to. Null when it has none.
- `status` (String) Status of the server, such as active, provisioning or suspended.
- `username` (String) Account set up for SSH login.

<a id="nestedatt--private_networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `private_networks`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) Address of the server in that network.
- `interface` (String) Network interface of the server in that network.
- `network` (String) Address of the private network, in CIDR notation.
